title: elatostema japonicum var. involucratum
intro: Elatostema japonicum var. involucratum, commonly known as Japanese Creeping Thyme, is a perennial plant species native to East Asia. It is used in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions like wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Elatostema japonicum var. involucratum include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
